summary: Shopware Community Edition is an open-source, PHP-based e-commerce platform designed to manage online stores and product catalogues. It provides a foundational framework for merchants to build and operate transactional websites with customisable storefronts and backend administration tools.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers and businesses looking for an MIT-licensed, self-hosted online retail system built on a PHP stack.
watchOut: Operating a PHP-based e-commerce application requires ongoing maintenance for security patches, dependency management, and performance tuning under traffic load.
deployNotes: You will typically need to provision a compatible PHP runtime, a relational database such as MySQL or MariaDB, and a web server configured with a reverse proxy for TLS termination and static asset handling.
